identity.name: Ipê Invest
identity.description: Fictional retail investment platform used to prove the white-label pipeline on a regulated-finance brand.
identity.audience: Retail investors who are not finance professionals.
identity.voice: Plain language, calm, never urgent. Numbers always with their unit and date.
identity.directives: Every monetary value carries currency and formatting for pt-BR and en-CA. Never imply guaranteed returns. All interactive states must meet WCAG 2.2 AA.

guidelines:
# Ipê Invest — Brand Guidelines

## Visual rules
- Deep green is the primary action colour; amber is reserved for highlights and never for destructive actions.
- Generous radius and soft elevation: surfaces read as cards, not panels.
- Data first: tables and figures use tabular numerals.

## Writing rules
- Sentence case everywhere.
- Say what happens next before asking the user to act.
- Regulatory text is visible, never hidden behind a tooltip.
